title: Finkd with Guard versus without Guard

method.name: finkd-guard-ablation-offline-v1
method.runOrder: Counterbalanced per item: withGuard/withoutGuard for even positions, reverse for odd positions
method.warmUp: One harmless local Llama routing/answer warm-up and one harmless Llama Guard warm-up; recorded separately and excluded
method.guardPlacement: Only before prospective cloud handoffs; inbound screening is deferred with cloud answers
method.scoring: MMLU-Pro leading option exact-match; synthetic ad campaign plus three numeric fields, with canary-leak penalty; no cloud grader
method.minimization: Remove all synthetic ad customer fields before both arms; apply the same local PII vault to both arms

prices.label: Illustrative pricing assumptions, not verified Muse Spark list prices
prices.tokenEstimator: ceil(character count / 4); actual provider usage is recorded separately
notes: All-cloud sends every query and the full top-k redacted retrieval context to Muse Spark.
Handoff sends only selected chunks when a safe handoff is needed.
Projected cost includes deferred handoffs and is not an observed invoice.
The local allowance is an illustrative electricity and hardware allocation, not a measurement.
Update these assumptions before making a purchasing decision.

baseline.name: Finkd published interim benchmark, different task suites

method.interpretation: Controlled current local Ollama transport with historical Finkd routing rules, not a rerun of all historical task suites. Offline latency excludes cloud completion. No unguarded cloud route exists in this runner.

limitations: Cloud answers, end-to-end cloud latency and inbound Guard decisions are deferred; inbound flagged is null, not a measured zero.
Accuracy is conditional on locally completed or blocked safe items; deferred answers are excluded with coverage shown.
Cost saving is a pricing-assumption projection, including deferred safe handoffs and the local allocation; actual cloud calls and charges are zero.
The selected slice is 10 public MMLU-Pro and 10 synthetic ad-privacy tasks; it is not the complete historical benchmark.
AB/BA ordering reduces but cannot eliminate caching, hardware and model-residency variation.
